model.name: R19.26: Drag is only activated when grabbing the icon element, not the whole item row.
model.description: rb-object-item drag MUST only initiate when the user grabs the icon element. Dragging from the name, description, or any other part of the item row MUST NOT start a drag. The draggable attribute or mousedown/touchstart handler must be scoped to the icon element only.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "drag is only activated when taking it on the icon."
